findings.title: Observer: Runs that end without a PR are re-run until quarantine, whatever the run said
findings.problem: New evidence for proposal #9901. The sweep treats every run that ends without a PR as stranded, even when the run explained why nothing could be done yet. On #858 the dependency run dropped the jsdom bump because it was inside pnpm's 1440-minute `minimumReleaseAge` window and said so ("The window closes at 2026-11-14T06:33Z. A run any time after that should land the bump"). The sweep re-ran it anyway; the retries said "Dropped the only bump again" and #858 was then quarantined (u40). #859 (electron, "published ... about eight hours before this run") ended the same way. #871 and #876 also hit the sweep ("the run left no PR and no comment; the stranded-unit sweep re-armed it") and were quarantined. Those two details say there was no comment, so they differ slightly from #9901's wording, and the records don't say why those runs ended without a PR. #876 also had a 2700s timeout (u30). The 858/859 runs fit #9901's cause directly.
findings.fix: As in #9901: when a run ends without a PR but left an explanatory comment or a 'nothing to do yet' result, don't count it toward quarantine. Hold the ticket until content changes or a delay passes, instead of re-arming it immediately.
